title: Diggy
summary: The whole world is solid rock. Dig your factory out of it by hand, prop up the ceilings you carve, and watch a cave-in bury whoever mined one pillar too many. Ore veins, tunnels, caverns and buried treasure surface only as you dig deeper. A standalone reimagining of RedMew's Diggy scenario for Factorio 2.0, playable solo or in multiplayer.
